prompt: Stage 5-1, level 8, 66 gold, 41 HP, five players left, 24 XP from level 9. Ahri and Sett are both 1-star with their items and you hold a spare copy of each. Seat 2 plays 2-star Ahri with two spares on the bench and Seat 5 holds one; nobody else has Ahri or Sett. Put the steps of this round in the order that gets the most out of the 66 gold.

lobby.note: Ahri 2-star with two spares on the bench, Blossom
Rapidfire Aphelios, one Ahri on the bench, no Sett

steps: Roll to the floor, buying every Sett and any 5-cost that fits, and stop at the stop condition even with gold left
Count the pool: your Ahri and Sett copies plus the ones on Seat 2's and Seat 5's boards and benches
Reposition against the next opponent with the new units before the timer ends
Level to 9 (24 gold) for the ninth slot and the 5-cost odds, and sell the bench units that are not part of the target
Set the target from the count: two Ahri left and eight Sett means roll for the Sett 2-star and a 5-cost, take an Ahri if one shows, floor 10

explanation:
The target depends on the pool, so the count comes first. Ten Ahri exist: you hold two, Seat 2 five, Seat 5 one; two remain. Ten Sett exist: you hold two, eight remain. At level 9 a slot is a 4-cost 33% of the time; with roughly 115 four-cost copies left, a Sett is in about 2.3% of slots and an Ahri in 0.6%. The 32 gold left after levelling is sixteen shops: they find a Sett more than four times in five and an Ahri one time in three. So the target is Sett 2-star plus a 5-cost, with Ahri a bonus you buy if she appears but never roll for.

Level before rolling: it takes 5-cost odds from 3% to 15% and gives the 5-cost a slot instead of a sale. Clear the bench at the same time so a hit never waits for space. Then roll to the floor without re-deciding, and reposition last: new units in old hexes lose fights the old board would have won.
principle: Count, then target, then level, then roll, then position. The count is the only step that can change the ones after it.
commonMistake: Pressing D before counting the pool, and finding out mid-roll that the carry has two copies left.
hint: Ask which step can change every step that comes after it, and put that one first.
